prompt.preamble:
We are testing a system for understanding people's interest in reading different kinds of online articles.
For example, you might be interested in articles about some topics, but not about others.
prompt.task_description: your preferences of what kinds of online articles you would like to read
prompt.final: In the final part of the study, you will give feedback on a test set of article headline and descriptions, which will enable us to see how well a chatbot reading your responses has learned what you like and dislike.
prompt.evaluation: Please indicate whether you would like to read the following articles: "yes" if you would, "no" if you would not.

conversation_history.message: What types of online communities or forums do you actively participate in, and what topics do you typically discuss or read about there?
I will read reddit posts about bikepacking. I like to watch youtube videos about AI, physics.
What types of books, magazines, or blogs do you enjoy reading in your free time, and what are the main subjects or themes that attract you to them?
I like all kinds of books - old russian literature, new books. Especially I like books with meaning. The subject itself isn't so important usually. I like blogs about machine learning and technology.
What types of documentaries, movies, or TV shows do you enjoy watching, and what themes or subjects do you find most engaging in them?
In terms of TV shows, I liked peaky blinders recently. I don't watch many movies, but I liked oppenheimer. Also, I like nature documentaries.
What types of podcasts or radio shows do you listen to, and what topics or themes do you find most intriguing in them?
I love the lex fridman podcast. It is about technology. also, long form podcasts like Joe Rogan are interesting to me.
What types of online courses or educational content do you seek out, and what subjects or skills are you most interested in learning or improving upon?
I seek out content related to exercise and machine learning/ai as well as mathematics. Skills I would like to improve on are music, mathematics, coding.
What types of art, music, or cultural events do you enjoy or have an interest in, and how do these interests influence or relate to your other hobbies and passions?
I am white, so not too many cultural events. I like all kinds of art -- funk, jazz, soul, old rap.
What types of news or current events are you most drawn to, and how do these topics intersect with your other interests such as technology, AI, and bikepacking?
I follow AI news pretty closely. also, modern politics is interesting.
What types of social issues or causes are you passionate about, and how do these interests influence your reading, viewing, or learning choices in areas such as AI, technology, and bikepacking?
I am passionate about service for others and the rise of big corporations draining the humanity out of everyday life.

query_prompt.content:
Your task is to learn what topics a user is interested in reading online article about. People's interests are broad, so you should seek to understand their interests across many topics; in other words, go for breadth rather than depth. Do not assume a user has given a complete answer to any question, so make sure to keep probing different types of interests.

Previous questions:
- [Q] -> [A]

Generate the most informative open-ended question that, when answered, will reveal the most about the desired behavior beyond what has already been queried for above. Make sure your question addresses different aspects of the user's interests than the questions that have already been asked. At the same time however, the question should be bite-sized, and not ask for too much at once. Generate the open-ended question and nothing else:
